name: OE_CONCEPTUAL_INVARIANTS_SUITE
description: Comprehensive conceptual invariants suite bridging theological Uncaused Cause with OE glass-box system. Fully atomic, literal-causal, and Popperian.

conceptual_framework.purpose: Integrate theological Uncaused Cause (Jesus) as pure causal explanation within OE glass-box boundary
conceptual_framework.methodology: Literal-causal representation, no metaphor, no category errors
conceptual_framework.epistemic_status: INVARIANT lane - survives current falsification attempts
conceptual_framework.falsification_requirement: All claims must have explicit falsification criteria

core_invariants.name: Causal Termination
core_invariants.description: All contingent causal chains must terminate in an Uncaused Cause
core_invariants.literal_interpretation: No infinite regress in causal explanations; every contingent being has a necessary causal source
falsification_criteria: Find a contingent being with no causal dependency
Demonstrate infinite causal regress without termination
Show contingent being that is its own cause
core_invariants.verification_protocol: Trace causal dependencies of any contingent entity; must terminate at Uncaused Cause
core_invariants.oe_integration: Maps to OE glass-box boundary requirement for complete causal accounting

core_invariants.name: Metaphysical Simplicity
core_invariants.description: Uncaused Cause is metaphysically simple (not composed of parts)
falsification_criteria: Demonstrate composition or parts in Uncaused Cause
Show potential for division or separation
Find any form of metaphysical complexity
core_invariants.oe_integration: Aligns with OE atomic instruction principle of irreducible elements

core_invariants.name: Pure Actuality
core_invariants.description: Uncaused Cause is pure actuality with no potentiality
falsification_criteria: Find unactualized potential in Uncaused Cause
Show capacity for change or development
core_invariants.verification_protocol: Check for temporal variation or developmental capacity; must be absent
core_invariants.oe_integration: Corresponds to OE invariant status - not provisional in storage

core_invariants.name: Necessary Existence
falsification_criteria: Show dependency on external conditions for existence
Find any scenario where Uncaused Cause could fail to exist
core_invariants.verification_protocol: Test for existential dependencies; must find none
core_invariants.oe_integration: Parallels OE requirement for non-negotiable lane separation

core_invariants.name: Creator of Contingents
core_invariants.description: All contingent beings depend on Uncaused Cause for existence
core_invariants.literal_interpretation: Every contingent entity has its being from the Uncaused Cause
falsification_criteria: Find contingent being independent of Uncaused Cause
Show contingent being that creates itself
Demonstrate contingent being with no causal origin
core_invariants.verification_protocol: Check causal origin of any contingent entity; must trace to Uncaused Cause
core_invariants.oe_integration: Matches OE evidence chain requirement - all artifacts must have traceable origin

psychological_bridges.name: Meaning Anchoring
psychological_bridges.description: Uncaused Cause provides stable ground for meaning in contingent world
psychological_bridges.oe_mapping: OE glass-box provides stable epistemic ground in contingent AI systems
psychological_bridges.verification: Check if meaning claims have stable reference point
psychological_bridges.falsification: Show meaning completely unanchored and arbitrary

psychological_bridges.name: Regress Prevention
psychological_bridges.description: Prevents infinite regress in causal reasoning
psychological_bridges.oe_mapping: OE prevents infinite regress in evidence chains

psychological_bridges.name: Moral Foundation
psychological_bridges.description: Provides stable ground for moral reasoning
psychological_bridges.oe_mapping: OE provides stable ground for procedural ethics
psychological_bridges.verification: Check if moral claims have non-arbitrary foundation

literalism_enforcement.rule: All theological claims must be interpreted literally as causal explanations
literalism_enforcement.oe_alignment: Matches OE prohibition against narrative and category errors

oe_repository_bridges.relationship: Theological Uncaused Cause implements OE atomic instruction principle of irreducible causal termination
oe_repository_bridges.verification: Check that both require complete causal accounting
oe_repository_bridges.falsification: Show contradiction in causal termination requirements

oe_repository_bridges.bridge: Uncaused Cause simplicity → OE lane separation
oe_repository_bridges.relationship: Metaphysical simplicity parallels strict lane separation (no mixing)
oe_repository_bridges.verification: Check that both enforce strict categorical boundaries
oe_repository_bridges.falsification: Show boundary violations in either system

oe_repository_bridges.relationship: Pure actuality (no potentiality) matches invariant status (not provisional in storage)
oe_repository_bridges.verification: Check that both reject provisional ontological status
oe_repository_bridges.falsification: Show provisional elements in either system

falsification_test_suite.procedure: Select random contingent entity from OE repository; trace causal dependencies
falsification_test_suite.success_criteria: Dependency chain terminates at Uncaused Cause
falsification_test_suite.failure_criteria: Chain continues infinitely or terminates elsewhere

falsification_test_suite.procedure: Attempt decomposition analysis of Uncaused Cause concept
Check for temporal or developmental variation in Uncaused Cause
falsification_test_suite.failure_criteria: Evidence of change, development, or unactualized potential

commit_message_structure.expected_failure: Any invariant fails literal-causal verification or OE integration

commit_discipline.note: Theological integration must survive same falsification rigor as OE procedural invariants

autofix_suggestions: Missing literal interpretation → Add causal explanation
Metaphor detected → Replace with literal causal claim
Category error (external belief) → Internalize as causal recognition
Missing falsification criteria → Add explicit falsification protocol
validation_rules: All claims must have literal-causal interpretation
No metaphor or poetic language allowed
All invariants must have explicit falsification criteria
All bridges must have verification procedures
